name: North Navigation Control Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Operating from its headquarters in Beijing, China, North Navigation Control Technology Co.,Ltd. delivers an array of military and civilian goods throughout the country. The company's diverse portfolio includes navigation and stability control systems, ammunition information technology detection solutions, and environmental control products. Furthermore, it produces radio and satellite communication equipment, electrical connectors, and various specialized vehicles, among other offerings. Founded in 1960, the enterprise was formerly known as China North Optical-Electrical Tech Co, before officially changing its name to North Navigation Control Technology Co.,Ltd. in April 2012.
